segments.text:
1
I Nebuchadnezer beyng at reſt in myne houſe and flouriſhyng in my palace,

2 Saw a dreame which made me afrayde, and thoughtes vppon my
bed and the viſions of myne head troubled me.
3 Therefore made I a decree that they ſhould bryng all the wiſe men of Babel before me, that they might declare vnto me the interpretation of the dreame.
